mapper.sql: l.id, l.elder_id, l.plan_id, l.take_date, l.remind_time, l.take_time, l.status, l.note, l.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_log (elder_id, plan_id, take_date, remind_time, take_time, status, note) VALUES (#{elderId}, #{planId}, #{takeDate}, #{remindTime}, #{takeTime}, #{status}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM medication_log l JOIN elder e ON e.id = l.elder_id WHERE l.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.owner_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT FROM medication_log l JOIN elder e ON e.id = l.elder_id WHERE l.elder_id = #{elderId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY l.take_date DESC, l.remind_time ASC, l.id ASC
